title: Evaporative Emissions Diagnostic Routing
introduction:
The evaporative emissions system (EVAP) contains fuel vapor and manages its later use by the engine. Its vapor plumbing serves a different purpose from the liquid-fuel supply. I treat a vapor-system code as a direction sign, not a fuel-pump shopping list.

Use the branches below to choose the next diagnostic reference according to whether a powertrain control module (PCM) diagnostic trouble code (DTC) is present. This page provides routing; the actual tests, measurements and completion checks belong to the referenced procedures.

edits.text: For a diagnostic trouble code (DTC) in the powertrain control module (PCM), refer to [Electronic Engine Controls](#/document/G1692931) (303-14B Electronic Engine Controls - 3.7L Duratec (227kW/301PS), Diagnosis and Testing).
edits.why: A PCM code directs you to the matching engine-control diagnostic information. It does not, by itself, establish which component needs replacement.

edits.text: For driveability symptoms without a DTC, refer to the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 3, Symptom Charts.
edits.why: A driveability complaint still has a diagnostic route when no code is present. The symptom charts are the specified next reference for that branch.
